claims.evidence: Witness only describes visible features (hybrid/fitness style, front suspension, disc brakes); no brand/model or condition details beyond what’s visible.
No readable drivetrain/gear count details in the witness report; no close-up of shifters, cassette/freewheel, or rear derailleur.
Both bikes are described as having front suspension forks.
No proof of purchase date/receipt or any identifying marks shown as readable.
Witness notes disc brakes are visible on the closer bike, but no pad/rotor wear, lever feel, or shifting performance is reported.
No rust inspection details are included; only a single angle description is provided.
No component-level verification (serials, exact drivetrain parts, replacement indicators) is shown.

risks.risk: Gear count and drivetrain condition may not match the claimed 18-speed; shifting may be worn or misadjusted.
risks.proof: A clear close-up video/photo of the rear derailleur + shifters and the rear cassette/freewheel showing the number of sprockets (and chainring teeth), plus a short clip of shifting through all gears without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used hybrid bicycle with unknown drivetrain condition (assume possible gear issues) until shifting/gear count is proven.

risks.risk: Brake condition may be worse than claimed (thin pads, worn rotor, air in hydraulic lines if applicable, or poor lever feel).
risks.proof: Close-up of brake pads and rotor wear (including rotor thickness/condition) and a clip showing firm braking from a standstill with no squeal/grinding and consistent lever feel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with brakes needing service/inspection (assume pads/rotor may require replacement) until brake performance is proven.

risks.risk: Tire condition and whether tires hold air may be poor (cracks, low tread, punctures).
risks.proof: Photos of both tires (tread depth and sidewalls) and a clip showing the bike pumped up/holding air (or a quick ride test with no wobble/slow leaks).
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing tire check/replacement risk until tire condition and air-holding are confirmed.

risks.risk: Wheel/bearing alignment issues (bent rim, bearing play, wobble) not visible from the single angle.
risks.proof: A clip of spinning each wheel and showing side-to-side wobble, plus a photo of rims for dents and a check of hub bearing play.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible wheel/bearing service risk until wheel trueness and bearing condition are confirmed.

risks.risk: Suspension fork may leak or have weak rebound/compression; front suspension is visible but performance isn’t tested.
risks.proof: A short bounce test clip (front end compresses and rebounds smoothly) and close-up photos of the fork stanchions for oil leaks/dust seals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as suspension may need servicing until fork leak-free operation and smooth action are proven.

risks.risk: Frame/fork damage (cracks, bends, rust) may exist but isn’t shown clearly from the reported angle.
risks.proof: Multiple photos: both sides of frame, head tube, fork crown, seat stays, and bottom bracket area in good light; include any crack/rust close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown structural condition (worst-case) until frame/fork integrity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Brand/model and bike size are unknown; wrong size reduces buyer value and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (seat tube/label) and a clear shot of any brand/model decals; include measurement of seat tube length.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic hybrid with unknown size (worst-case fit risk) until size/identity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness may be missing (lights, kickstand, lock, pump, helmet), affecting value.
risks.proof: A full layout photo/video of all included accessories and whether both bikes have the same items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bicycle-only (no extras) until completeness is confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo/video of the shifters and rear derailleur, and a shot of the rear cassette/freewheel showing the sprocket count (to confirm 18-speed).
Send a short clip demonstrating shifting through all gears without skipping and braking from a standstill with good lever feel.
Provide close-up photos of brake pads and rotor condition (front and rear if present).
Provide tire close-ups (tread + sidewalls) and confirm whether tires hold air (or show a pump/pressure check).
Provide wheel spin clips to check wobble and hub bearing play.
Provide fork close-ups for oil leaks and a bounce/rebound test clip.
Provide multiple photos of the frame/fork from both sides and the head tube/bottom bracket for cracks or rust.
Provide frame size marking/seat tube length measurement and any readable brand/model decals.
response.reason: The witness confirms the bikes are hybrid/fitness style with front suspension and disc brakes, but key value drivers (gear count/drivetrain condition, brake wear, tire/wheel/suspension health, and exact size/identity) are not verifiable from the report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
